title: Computer Science Core Question Pool
description: Dynamic Question Pool where each student receives 5 randomly sampled questions from this bank on every attempt.

questions.text: Which data structure follows the First In, First Out (FIFO) principle?
questions.explanation: Queues operate on a FIFO basis, where items are dequeued in the order they were enqueued.

questions.text: What is the average lookup time complexity in a balanced Binary Search Tree (e.g., AVL or Red-Black Tree)?
questions.explanation: Self-balancing binary trees maintain height proportional to $\log N$, guaranteeing $O(\log N)$ search time.

questions.text: What will be printed to stdout?
questions.explanation: `b` and `a` reference the exact same underlying list in memory, so appending to `b` alters `a`.

questions.text: What keyword is used in JavaScript to declare an immutable block-scoped variable binding?
questions.explanation: `const` declares block-scoped constants that cannot be reassigned through re-assignment.

questions.text: Order these sorting algorithms by their worst-case time complexity, from best to worst:
questions.explanation: Merge Sort and Heap Sort have $O(N \log N)$ worst cases, while QuickSort and Selection Sort can degrade to $O(N²)$.

questions.text: Match the database design concept with its definition:

matchingPairs.right: Unique identifier for each record in a table
Field establishing relational link between two tables
Data structure improving query lookup performance
Process minimizing data redundancy and anomalies

questions.text: In distributed computing, what does the 'C' represent in Brewer's CAP Theorem?
questions.explanation: CAP theorem states distributed systems trade off Consistency, Availability, and Partition Tolerance.

questions.text: What is the output of `bool([])` in Python?
questions.explanation: Empty collections in Python evaluate to `False` in boolean contexts.

questions.text: Which network protocol is connectionless and does not guarantee packet delivery order?
questions.explanation: User Datagram Protocol (UDP) is a connectionless transport protocol prioritizing speed over delivery guarantee.

questions.text: What is the space complexity of Depth First Search (DFS) on a balanced binary tree of depth $H$?
questions.explanation: DFS call stack memory usage is proportional to the tree height $H$.
